Mirai Nawakiri is a half demon of Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena.

Personality
She fights for justice, Mirai is proud and confident, which can lead to her revealing parts of her ability. Mirai likes children and protects them, risking her own life for others. She does not wish to become a demon.

While, never seen, it is speculated that if she overextends the 5-minute limit or takes off the control device on her arm, she will lose control of herself and go on a rampage.

Appearance
She has black long hair, her eyes are red and blue depending on her activation of demonic blood.

History
Background
Born human, with little information about her past given.

She lost her family, in a battle between Demon Tribes and Taimanin, she herself was effected by the demons and almost transformed into a demon, and in a moment of confusion killed a number of people, which made her also a target of the Taimanin, her transformation was not complete, and she spends her time as a half-demon, hunted by demon, Taimanin and by UFS, which wishes to have her as a test sample.

She is currently a demon hunter and is using Taimanin-like abilities. Thanks to a control device on her left arm, she can control her demonic blood and prevent a full transformation. If she releases the device, she has around 5 minutes in which she is able to use her Ninja Art, Flame Rope.

She now protects the streets of Amidahara and its children, living together with them in the slum areas.

Timeline TABA
Does only appear in her "what if" event. Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) followed the rumor of Mirai. Placing a recording device on the ground, which spoke the name "Ootsuki" she reacted strangely to the name, and was caught off-guard. Kotaro used a taken ability, "Belial Sword" to copy her fire blade and defeated her, as he let her timer ran out. Kotaro forced her afterward to work for him.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Katana Taima Blade "Soul spirit"

Magic Blade: Able to cut not just physical, but also spiritual things. (Souls, Ghosts, Ninja Arts, Magic)
Control Device: Demon Blood Release, using the Code 023574, she is able to infuse her body with her demon blood for 5 minutes. This enables her to use something like Ninja Arts.
Ninja Art: "Fire Art", "Flame Rope", able to create a flame like rope, which envelops her blade, making it a flame sword.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.
